missing_authority: Country-specific/variant native wording for v149_se is not page-bound in the flattened primary EVS questionnaire.
source_basis: Implementation label says “one needs children,” but the flattened primary source exposes v149 as the woman-specific wording; authority law says unresolved binding must remain blocked, not inferred.
resolution_needed: Country-specific/variant native wording for v149_se is not page-bound in the flattened primary EVS questionnaire.

missing_authority: Source does not establish that legal marriage is the same state as the norm’s long-term stable relationship requirement.
source_basis: Q45B names marriage OR long-term stable relationship as necessary to happiness; Q87 only records legal marriage to current partner and does not establish relationship duration/stability or the happiness criterion.
resolution_needed: Source does not establish that legal marriage is the same state as the norm’s long-term stable relationship requirement.

missing_authority: Need source-proven husband+wife dual-income composition tying respondent/spouse roles to contribution to household income.
source_basis: Norm requires both husband and wife to contribute to household income; available employment/chief-wage-earner fields do not establish the required couple roles and contribution predicate.
resolution_needed: Need source-proven husband+wife dual-income composition tying respondent/spouse roles to contribution to household income.

missing_authority: Need source-explicit authority that respondent income/tax willingness realizes the government’s obligation to reduce pollution.
source_basis: The source ties v8/v9 contributions to preventing pollution but v10 assigns reduction to government; T15 forbids importing a cross-actor means bridge without source/governed authority.
resolution_needed: Need source-explicit authority that respondent income/tax willingness realizes the government’s obligation to reduce pollution.

missing_authority: Need married-woman respondent/spouse identity and husband-capable-of-supporting condition.
source_basis: Norm is conditional on a married woman whose husband can support her; spouse-ever-work does not preserve the woman/husband/support condition.
resolution_needed: Need married-woman respondent/spouse identity and husband-capable-of-supporting condition.

missing_authority: Need source-proven couple composition establishing man outside-work role AND woman home/family-care role.
source_basis: Employment histories do not establish the two-sided gendered household-role state named by the norm.
resolution_needed: Need source-proven couple composition establishing man outside-work role AND woman home/family-care role.

missing_authority: Need source-explicit/governed bridge that environmental protest is a means of satisfying “respect nature”.
source_basis: Environmental protest is a plausible social means but source does not define it as enactment of this religious/nature norm; ideology/common-sense bridge is forbidden.
resolution_needed: Need source-explicit/governed bridge that environmental protest is a means of satisfying “respect nature”.

missing_authority: Need source-native parent-child co-residence state, not generic marital/household metadata.
source_basis: Assigned implementation universe does not provide a single source-bound endpoint proving an aged parent lives with an adult child; household composition cannot be assumed.
resolution_needed: Need source-native parent-child co-residence state, not generic marital/household metadata.

missing_authority: Need source-native aged-parent/adult-child co-residence composition with exact relationship and age roles.
source_basis: Generic marital/household status does not establish the exact living-with-children state.
resolution_needed: Need source-native aged-parent/adult-child co-residence composition with exact relationship and age roles.

missing_authority: Need source endpoint establishing exercise/compliance with a gun-permit regime.
source_basis: Gun ownership does not establish whether a permit was obtained or whether ownership exercises the specific permit rule.
resolution_needed: Need source endpoint establishing exercise/compliance with a gun-permit regime.

missing_authority: Praxis must establish law-breaking under the norm’s difficult-situation condition.
source_basis: q149 permits government law-disregard only when country faces a difficult situation; q112 measures leader law-breaking generally, so condition identity is absent.
resolution_needed: Praxis must establish law-breaking under the norm’s difficult-situation condition.

missing_authority: Need source proof that government deciding allowable ideas entails restriction of speech.
source_basis: q143 can logically coexist with q108 if government permits the ideas; free speech is not a source-proven contrary practice at the question grain.
resolution_needed: Need source proof that government deciding allowable ideas entails restriction of speech.

missing_authority: Need source-explicit relation between judicial acceptance of executive views and courts being unable to constrain law-breaking leaders.
source_basis: The source measures two different institutional properties; causal/functional connection would be worker-supplied, which T15 forbids.
resolution_needed: Need source-explicit relation between judicial acceptance of executive views and courts being unable to constrain law-breaking leaders.

missing_authority: Need population/gender comparative participation state; one respondent’s voting does not establish “women less involved than men”.
source_basis: q139 is comparative gender participation; q78 is individual voting history. Female-instance routing alone cannot recover the comparative predicate.
resolution_needed: Need population/gender comparative participation state; one respondent’s voting does not establish “women less involved than men”.

missing_authority: Need source authority equating reduction of income differences with perceived fairness of income distribution.
source_basis: The source separately measures inequality-reduction responsibility and fairness; neither entails the other without an external theory bridge.
resolution_needed: Need source authority equating reduction of income differences with perceived fairness of income distribution.

missing_authority: Need source-native bridge from broad social justice to fair distribution of wealth.
source_basis: Fair wealth distribution may be an instance of social justice, but this narrowing is not explicitly defined by the source battery.
resolution_needed: Need source-native bridge from broad social justice to fair distribution of wealth.

missing_authority: Need source bridge showing freedom of political participation is realization of actual citizen participation.
source_basis: The norm names participation; praxis names guaranteed freedom/opportunity to participate. Enabling freedom is not itself participation without a bridge.
resolution_needed: Need source bridge showing freedom of political participation is realization of actual citizen participation.

missing_authority: Need source bridge from individual citizen helping action to a country-level guarantee of solidarity.
source_basis: Shared poor/needy target is insufficient: actor changes citizen→country/social state and action changes help→guaranteed solidarity.
resolution_needed: Need source bridge from individual citizen helping action to a country-level guarantee of solidarity.

missing_authority: Need governed response-pole mapping between justifiability of tax evasion and prevalence of proper tax payment.
source_basis: The variables are inverse predicates at question grain; without response-position mapping the praxis cannot be labeled violation/satisfaction safely. Strict P21STB↔P72ST remains T06.
resolution_needed: Need governed response-pole mapping between justifiability of tax evasion and prevalence of proper tax payment.
